note: Reviewed by reading every generated tale type, not by running a screen over it. The automated screens in lib/safety.ts decide what reaches this file; this file decides what reaches the app. A record can veto an entry but never resurrect one: anything the screens rejected is already gone before build-catalogue.ts reads this. verdict is 'safe' or 'unsafe'; an unsafe record carries the reason it was cut, so the judgement can be argued with later. Blurbs are written from the canonical title and the motifs recorded against the type, and are bedtime framings rather than summaries of the scholarly record.
